title: Hardware Procurement Terms: Quote Approval, Deposit Invoicing and the Purchase Order
content:
## Clause 1. Approval within the validity period

1.1 A Hardware Procurement quote may be approved only by the authorized contact's signature within the order type's quote validity days after the quote was issued.

1.2 The validity period is counted in calendar days from the quote date, that date being day 0, and a signature on the last day is in time. The clock starts from the issue of the quote, and the date that proves it is the quote date shown on the system record of that same order; what the client says about when it received the quote does not move it.

1.3 Boundary cases, for a hypothetical quote with a 14-day validity: a signature on day 14 after the quote date is in time; a signature on day 15 is not. For a 7-day validity, day 7 is in time and day 8 is not.

## Clause 2. Price protection

Where the order type honours the signed price after approval, the signed price holds even if the distributor cost changes before the purchase order.

## Clause 3. Deposit invoice on approval

3.1 The clause "On approval a required deposit of the order type's deposit percentage of the quote total is invoiced, rounded half up to the cent, due on receipt" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every order. It no longer governs a Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order approved within the client's credit limit, which follows the endpoint deposit schedule, or a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order approved within the client's credit limit, which follows the infrastructure deposit schedule. On those orders the deposit is still invoiced on approval, rounded half up to the cent and due on receipt.

3.2 Every other order, including any order whose approval would take the client over its credit limit, keeps this deposit: a required deposit of the order type's deposit percentage of the quote total, or 100 percent of the quote total whatever the deposit percentage and deposit threshold say when the approval would take the client over its credit limit, invoiced on approval, rounded half up to the cent and due on receipt.

3.3 Hypothetical illustration of 3.2: a required deposit of 100 percent on a quote total of 3210.55 is 3210.55; a required deposit of 25 percent on a quote total of 6000.10 is 1500.025, rounded half up to 1500.03.

## Clause 4. Purchase order

4.1 The purchase order may be placed only after any required deposit has been paid in full. Whether it has been paid is read from the order's own billing ledger: its deposit invoice and the payments recorded against that order.

4.2 Orders that need no deposit are placed on the approval date.

4.3 A configuration sheet must be signed before staging starts where the order type requires a signed configuration sheet.

superseded_clauses: On approval a required deposit of deposit_pct percent of the quote total is invoiced, rounded half up to the cent, due on receipt (deposit_due).
